name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again' is correctly a hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box), since 'very next' demands holding_box on the step right after box_fell (and box_fell and holding_box never coincide, so holding_box then means a pickup). 'If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box' is correctly a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) alone: reaching the exit is only the condition of an 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is added, and since at_exit holds only on the ending step, the promise must be fulfilled there. Both clauses are conditionals, so the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: If box_fell occurs, holding_box must occur at the next step.
If at_exit occurs, holding_box must occur at some point at or after it.
